verdict.rationale: Fly.io is a global cloud hosting platform with an Anycast edge network, so invisible, challenge-based bot protection is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains nothing about bot detection, invisible challenges, or traffic filtering. Egress policies, hardware-isolated VMs and secrets management are adjacent security features that do not deliver this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can protect my app from automated bot traffic with invisible challenge-based protection
